name: Hologram Documentation
description: Read-only agent surface for Hologram — the DERO decentralized web browser. Loads TELA dApps from chain, signs in to HTTPS sites with a DERO wallet, validates on-chain proofs, and runs offline-first with a built-in block explorer. 300+ API methods across 30 functional areas.

skills.name: Load and browse TELA dApps
skills.description: Discover, fetch, and render TELA dApps directly from the DERO blockchain inside the Hologram browser, with on-chain proof validation and offline-first behavior.
examples: How does Hologram load a TELA app from chain?
What proofs does Hologram validate before rendering content?

skills.name: Sign in to any HTTPS site with a DERO wallet
skills.description: HOLOGRAM-exclusive: authenticate on any HTTPS website using a DERO wallet address — no extensions, no passwords, no seed phrases exposed to the browser.
examples: How does Sign In with DERO work?
What signature scheme does Hologram use for wallet auth?
Can I integrate Sign In with DERO on my Next.js site?

skills.name: Use the built-in block explorer
skills.description: Inspect blocks, transactions, smart contracts, and DERO Name Service registrations from inside Hologram without leaving the browser.
examples: Show me the registered owner of a given DERO name.

skills.name: Search and navigate Hologram documentation
skills.description: Full-text search across the Hologram docs corpus — 300+ API methods across 30 functional areas. Every page has a `.md` mirror for direct agent ingestion.
examples: Find docs on Hologram TELA browser.
List Hologram API methods for wallet operations.
How do I run Hologram in offline mode?

none.description: Public read-only documentation; site content requires no authentication. Daemon RPC and hosted MCP HTTP transport apply their own authentication where configured.

privacy_posture.rationale: DERO is a privacy-first chain; its docs surface honors the same posture.
